verses.en: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
verses.pt: Além disso fez um altar de bronze de vinte côvados de comprimento, vinte de largura e dez de altura.

verses.en: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.pt: Fez também o mar de fundição; era redondo e media dez côvados duma borda à outra, cinco de altura e trinta de circunferencia.

verses.en: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.
verses.pt: Por baixo da borda figuras de bois que cingiam o mar ao redor, dez em cada côvado, contornando-o todo; os bois estavam em duas fileiras e foram fundidos juntamente com o mar.

verses.en: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.pt: O mar estava assentado sobre doze bois, três dos quais olhavam para o norte, três para o ocidente, três para o sul, e três para o oriente; e o mar estava posto sobre os bois, cujas ancas estavam todas para a banda de dentro.

verses.en: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.
verses.pt: Tinha quatro dedos de grossura; e a sua borda foi feita como a borda dum copo, como a flor dum lírio; e cabiam nele mais de três mil batos.

verses.en: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.pt: Fez também dez pias; e pôs cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda, para lavarem nelas; isto é, lavaram nelas o que pertencia ao holocausto. Porém o mar era para os sacerdotes se lavarem nele.

verses.en: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
verses.pt: E fez dez castiçais de ouro, segundo o que fora ordenado a respeito deles, e pô-los no templo, cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda.

verses.en: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.
verses.pt: Também fez dez mesas, e pô-las no templo, cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda; e fez ainda cem bacias de ouro.

verses.en: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
verses.pt: Fez mais o átrio dos sacerdotes, e o átrio grande, e as suas portas, as quais revestiu de bronze.

verses.en: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.
verses.pt: E pôs o mar ao lado direito da casa, a sudeste.

verses.en: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;
verses.pt: Hurão fez ainda as caldeiras, as pás e as bacias. Assim completou Hurão a obra que fazia para o rei Salomão na casa de Deus:

verses.en: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;
verses.pt: as duas colunas, os globos, e os dois capitéis no alto das colunas; as duas redes para cobrir os dois globos dos capitéis que estavam no alto das colunas;

verses.en: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.
verses.pt: e as quatrocentas romãs para as duas redes, duas fileiras de romãs para cada rede, para cobrirem os dois globos dos capitéis que estavam em cima das colunas.

verses.en: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;
verses.pt: Também fez as bases, e as pias sobre as bases;

verses.en: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
verses.pt: o mar, e os doze bois debaixo dele.

verses.en: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.
verses.pt: Semelhantemente as caldeiras, as pás, os garfos e todos os vasos, os fez Hurão-Abi de bronze luzente para o rei Salomão, para a casa do Senhor.

verses.en: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.
verses.pt: Na campina do Jordão os fundiu o rei, na terra argilosa entre Sucote e Zeredá.

verses.en: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
verses.pt: Salomão fez todos estes vasos em grande abundância, de sorte que o peso do bronze não se podia averiguar.

verses.en: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;
verses.pt: Assim fez Salomão todos os vasos que eram para a casa de Deus, o altar de ouro, as mesas para os pães da proposição,

verses.en: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;
verses.pt: os castiçais com as suas lâmpadas, de ouro puro, para arderem perante o oráculo, segundo a ordenança;

verses.en: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;
verses.pt: as flores, as lâmpadas e as tenazes, de ouro puríssimo,

verses.en: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.
verses.pt: como também as espevitadeiras, as bacias, as colheres e os braseiros, de ouro puro. Quanto à entrada da casa, tanto as portas internas, do lugar santíssimo, como as portas da casa, isto é, do santuário, eram de ouro.
